originating_goal: Activate the completed SDK sovereign fallback and public governance execution corrections for users without granting GitHub Actions or non-TV/TVC credentials release authority.
trigger: canonical main contains release-worthy SDK corrections that are not yet present in an observable verified distributed package
deterministic_inputs: latest published release tag and target SHA
required_outputs: release source containing required_source_commit or a canonical successor
package verification receipt proving corrected 0A/0B/1/2/000/fallback surfaces are present
credential-boundary receipt showing release authority remained TV/TVC and GitHub token production authority remained NONE
completion_condition: A TV/TVC-authorized release/package is observable, its source contains required_source_commit, the distributed package is verified to contain every required surface, and the task records COMPLETE evidence.
blocked_condition: TV/TVC release authorization or sovereign release executor is unavailable.
blocked_release_condition: Machine-observable TV/TVC release authorization/executor becomes available.
retry_condition: An authorized release is initiated but release/package observability or package verification is not yet complete.
review_required_condition: Canonical main gains a later release-worthy SDK correction after this refresh; recompute the candidate so no required correction is omitted.
failed_condition: Published release/tag/package evidence is inconsistent, omits required_source_commit ancestry or any required surface, or uses a prohibited credential authority; fail closed and do not represent the SDK correction as user-activated.
collision_boundaries: Do not grant GitHub Actions tag, release, push, PyPI, or credential authority.
Do not use GitHub token as runtime or production release authority.
Do not use non-TV/TVC secrets or tokens.
Do not publish an unvalidated newer candidate silently; move to REVIEW_REQUIRED when release-worthy main changes.
Do not represent source-on-main as distributed user activation.
current_evidence: .github/workflows/headless-release.yml is validation-only and assigns actual release execution to sovereign/local TV/TVC tooling
latest published GitHub release observed as v1.0.12
public fallback, canonical result-alias correction, ordinary 0A/1/2 execution, and executable 000/0B source are newer than v1.0.13
latest 000/0B focused tests are committed but not yet claimed PASS
next_executable_action: Credential-free sovereign SDK validation lane executes the current focused tests; after PASS evidence, TV/TVC-authorized sovereign release lane resolves the release candidate from canonical main, publishes through approved authority, verifies distributed package contents, and updates this task to COMPLETE or a precise BLOCKED/RETRY/REVIEW_REQUIRED/FAILED state.
archive_dependency: Release credentials and activation execution are machine-owned and do not need to remain in chat. Product activation remains incomplete until this task reaches COMPLETE with package verification.
